ios.desc:
Fermentation companion for beginners and experienced makers alike.
Whether you're brewing kombucha, baking sourdough, or crafting sauerkraut, this app helps you create, track, and refine every batch.

### Recipes ###
Discover safe, reliable, and inspiring recipes for kombucha, kefir, sauerkraut, sourdough, and more.
Follow step-by-step guidance or add and customize your own recipes to suit your taste and process. 

### Batch History ###
Improve with every batch.
Track your fermentation journey, experiment with variations, and log notes and photos.
Easily revisit past batches to learn what worked best and what didn’t.

### Fermentation Tools ###
Handy calculators and converters to help you follow the evolution of your cultures.

quotes.text:
I'm working on FermentMe, an app for tracking fermentation projects like kombucha and sourdough. It keeps a history of your batches so you can look back at what you changed and compare Co2, acidity evolutions etc when experimenting with recipes or fermentation times.

android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fermentme.app 
ios: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/fermentme-recipes-tracker/id6761524491
